{
  "status": "needs_clarification",
  "rationale": "The user requires optimization of the stacking order (SiO2/TiO2 vs TiO2/SiO2) and thicknesses. The bounded TMM task schema supports optimizing layer thicknesses but does not support discrete optimization of material identity or sequence within a single experiment. Two separate experiments are required to compare the two fixed sequences.",
  "normalized_request_english": "Perform deterministic TMM optimization for two distinct planar two-layer AR coating designs on glass (n=1.52) from air (n=1.0). Design 1: Air | SiO2 | TiO2 | Glass. Design 2: Air | TiO2 | SiO2 | Glass. For each design, optimize layer thicknesses in [40, 160] nm to minimize mean reflectance at s-polarization, 0 degrees incidence, over 450-700 nm. Report best stack order, thicknesses, and spectrum.",
  "experiments": [],
  "uncertainty": {
    "thickness_sigma_nm": 1.0,
    "thickness_error_model": "absolute_normal",
    "thickness_relative_fraction": 0.0,
    "thickness_samples": 16,
    "angle_perturbation_deg": 0.0,
    "material_dataset_policy": "resolved_only",
    "maximum_material_scenarios": 8,
    "random_seed": 17
  }
}
